definitions: To establish one's presence or claim in a particular area or situation, often in a way that asserts dominance or ownership.
To make it clear that a particular area, position, or subject belongs to or is controlled by oneself.
examples: The new manager quickly started to mark territory by implementing several changes.
She made sure to mark her territory in the project by taking charge of the most critical tasks.
The company is trying to mark its territory in the emerging market.
